branches.en: RESISTANCE: the frame pushes back against movement — hold back a crowd, hold back tears.
branches.cn: 抵抗：框逆着运动方向推回去——拦住人群、忍住眼泪。

branches.en: OWNERSHIP: what stays in your grip is yours; a position held is a place occupied.
branches.cn: 归属：留在你握中的东西归你；被握住的职位就是一个被占据的位置。

branches.en: CONTINUITY: events, opinions and rules are held — kept in existence, kept in mind, kept valid.
branches.cn: 延续：活动、观点和规则被'握住'——保持存在、保持在心里、保持有效。

intro.en: hold combines with particles and prefixes that shift the frame: upward, backward, outward, or around a whole house.
intro.cn: hold 与小品词和前缀组合，改变'框'的方向：向上、向后、向外，或者围住整个家。

latinIntro.en: Latin tenere 'to hold' (stem ten-/tain-) produced a large English family: contain, retain, maintain, detain, tenant. It is a separate borrowing with the same core meaning, not a cognate of hold.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tenere'握住'（词干 ten-/tain-）在英语里造出了一个大家族：contain、retain、maintain、detain、tenant。这是另一条借入路径，核心意思相同，但不是 hold 的同源词。

items.meaning: a person who holds something, or an object made to hold something
items.meaningCN: 持有者；支架、容器（-er 表示做这个动作的人或物）
items.example: Put the pen back in its holder.
items.exampleCN: 把笔放回笔座里。

items.meaning: the act of holding; shares or property that someone owns
items.meaningCN: 持有；股份、资产（-ing 把动作变成名词）
items.example: She has a large holding in the company.
items.exampleCN: 她持有这家公司大量股份。

items.meaning: to support or confirm a law, decision, or principle
items.meaningCN: 支持、维护（法律、裁决、原则）（up- 表示'向上托住'）
items.example: The court upheld the original decision.
items.exampleCN: 法院维持了原判。

items.meaning: to keep something back and refuse to give it
items.meaningCN: 扣留；拒绝给予（with- 表示'往回、离开'）
items.example: The company withheld his pay for a week.
items.exampleCN: 公司扣了他的工资一周。

items.meaning: all the people living together in one house; the home as a unit
items.meaningCN: 一家人；家庭（hold 在中古英语里指'住所'）
items.example: The whole household shares the chores.
items.exampleCN: 全家一起分担家务。

items.meaning: a place where your foot can rest; a small position from which to advance
items.meaningCN: 落脚点；立足点、据点
items.example: The climbers found a foothold on the rock.
items.exampleCN: 攀登者在岩壁上找到了一个落脚点。

latinEntries.meaning: to keep something and not lose it
to hold something inside; to have within itself
to keep something in good condition; to keep a claim standing
to keep someone from leaving; to delay

groups.definition_en: to continue to have something, or to stay in a state or course of action
groups.scene: 考试前老师说 Please keep quiet during the exam.
groups.sceneCN: 这里 keep 是「保持（某种状态）」（第 2 个义项）；句意：考试期间请保持安静。

pos.zh: 使保持（某种状态）；继续做

senses.title: Keep it: continue to have
senses.definition: to continue to have something and not give it away
senses.definitionCN: 继续拥有某物，不把它给出去
senses.example: You can keep the book; I have another copy.
senses.exampleCN: 这本书你留着吧，我还有一本。
senses.why: The core is continuation, not grasp. The object stays in your possession across time; nothing moves, and that is exactly the point.
senses.whyCN: 核心是'持续'，不是'抓'。东西在时间里一直留在你的所有范围内；什么都没动，而这正是要点。

senses.title: Keep warm: stay in a state
senses.definition: to stay, or to make someone or something stay, in a particular state
senses.definitionCN: （使）保持某种状态
senses.example: Keep warm and drink plenty of water.
senses.exampleCN: 注意保暖，多喝水。
senses.why: A state is treated like an object you can hold in place. The adjective names the state, and keep says: do not let it change.
senses.whyCN: 一种状态被当作可以'按住'的东西。形容词说出是什么状态，keep 则说：别让它变。

senses.title: Keep talking: continue an action
senses.definition: to continue doing something, or to do it repeatedly
senses.definitionCN: 继续做某事；反复做
senses.example: She kept talking even after everyone had left.
senses.exampleCN: 大家都走了，她还在讲。
senses.why: An action is stretched along the time line instead of an object being held. Keep + -ing means the action is not allowed to stop.
senses.whyCN: 这里被拉长时间线的不是物体，而是一个动作。keep + -ing 表示这个动作不被允许停下来。

senses.title: Keep a promise: observe faithfully
senses.definition: to do what you have promised or agreed to do
senses.definitionCN: 履行、遵守（承诺、约定、规矩）
senses.example: He always keeps his word.
senses.exampleCN: 他总是守信。
senses.why: This is one of the oldest senses: cepan was used around the year 1000 to translate Latin observare 'watch over, heed'. To keep a promise is to watch over it until it is done.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项之一：约公元 1000 年，cēpan 就被用来翻译拉丁语 observare'看守、留意'。守约就是把承诺看住，直到它兑现。

senses.title: Keep a secret: hold it inside
senses.definition: to not tell other people something private
senses.definitionCN: 不把私密的事告诉别人
senses.example: Can you keep a secret?
senses.exampleCN: 你能守住秘密吗？
senses.why: A secret is information inside your boundary. Keeping it means the boundary holds and nothing leaks out — guarding, not owning.
senses.whyCN: 秘密是边界里面的信息。守住它，意味着边界不破、没有东西漏出去——这是'看守'，不是'拥有'。

senses.title: Keep the sheep in: prevent from leaving
senses.definition: to stop people or animals from leaving or entering a place
senses.definitionCN: 阻止人或其他动物离开或进入某处
senses.example: The fence keeps the sheep in the field.
senses.exampleCN: 栅栏把羊拦在田里。
senses.why: Here keep is a boundary in action: the fence holds the animals inside the frame. The verb describes the frame's effect, not the owner's hand.
senses.whyCN: 这里的 keep 是'边界在起作用'：栅栏把羊留在框里。动词描述的是框的效果，而不是主人的手。

senses.title: Keep bees: look after, maintain
senses.definition: to own and look after animals, or to run a shop or business
senses.definitionCN: 饲养（动物）；经营（店铺、生意）
senses.example: They keep bees and sell the honey.
senses.exampleCN: 他们养蜂，卖蜂蜜。
senses.why: This is the verb's oldest layer: 'tend, watch over' — cattle, bees, a shop. What you keep, you maintain day after day, so keeping becomes a livelihood.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词最老的一层意思：'照料、看管'——看牛、养蜂、看店。你 keep 的东西，需要日复一日地维持，于是'照料'变成了'营生'。

senses.title: Milk keeps for three days: stay fresh
senses.definition: to stay in good condition; to not spoil
senses.definitionCN: （食物等）保持不坏、不变质
senses.example: Milk keeps for about three days in the fridge.
senses.exampleCN: 牛奶在冰箱里大约能放三天。
senses.why: The subject is now the thing itself, and keep is intransitive: the state of being good continues on its own. What is preserved is the same state over time.
senses.whyCN: 这里主语变成了东西本身，keep 也不带宾语：'完好'这个状态自己延续下去。被保住的是同一状态在时间中的延续。

senses.title: Earn your keep: food and lodging
senses.definition: the food, shelter, and money needed to support a person or animal
senses.definitionCN: 维持生活所需的食宿和费用
senses.example: He works on the farm for his keep.
senses.exampleCN: 他在农场干活，换取食宿。
senses.why: The noun turns maintenance into a thing: what is needed to keep you alive. The verb's care becomes the cost of being cared for.
senses.whyCN: 名词把'维持'变成了一样东西：让你活下去所需要的。动词的'照料'变成了'被照料的代价'。

senses.title: The castle keep: the part that holds
senses.definition: the strong central tower of a castle; also, in for keeps, permanently
senses.definitionCN: 城堡中央坚固的主楼；for keeps 表示'永久地、当真地'
senses.example: The old keep still stands on the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 那座古老的主楼仍立在山丘上。
senses.why: A keep is 'that which keeps' — the stronghold that holds out attackers. For keeps extends the same idea to time: what is kept is not given back.
senses.whyCN: keep 作名词指'守住的那个东西'——抵挡进攻的坚固据点。for keeps 把同一个想法延伸到时间上：被 keep 住的东西不再还回去。

intro.en: keep appears suddenly in written English around the year 1000, already with many senses. Its deeper origin is uncertain, and that uncertainty should be stated rather than hidden.
intro.cn: keep 大约在公元 1000 年突然出现在书面英语中，而且一出现就带着许多义项。它更早的来源并不确定，这一点应当说明，而不是掩盖。

items.en: cepan (past tense cepte) meant 'to seize, hold; to seek after, desire', and also 'to observe or carry out in practice; to look out for, pay attention to'. It was used around 1000 to translate Latin observare.
items.cn: cēpan（过去式 cepte）意为'抓住、握住；追求、渴望'，也表示'遵守、践行；留意、关注'。约公元 1000 年它被用来翻译拉丁语 observare。

items.en: The ancestor is reconstructed as *kopjan, but its origin is uncertain. One suggestion links it to Old English capian 'to look' (from *kap-), which would give a basic sense 'keep an eye on, see to it'. Some older notes connect it with cēap 'bargain, purchase' (the source of cheap), but that is not generally accepted. Treat both as hypotheses.
items.cn: 祖词被重构为原始日耳曼语 *kopjan，但来源不确定。一种说法把它和古英语 capian'看'（来自 *kap-）联系起来，这样基本义就是'盯着、留意'。一些较早的笔记把它和 cēap'交易、购买'（cheap 的来源）联系起来，但这并非普遍接受的看法。两种都只应当作假设。

items.en: Middle English kēpen expanded in every direction: 'guard, defend' (12c.); 'restrain' (early 13c.); 'take care of, protect' (mid-13c.); 'preserve, maintain, carry on' a shop (mid-14c.); 'prevent from leaving' and 'preserve without loss or change' (late 14c.); 'stay, remain' (early 15c.); 'continue doing' (mid-15c.).
items.cn: 中古英语 kēpen 向各个方向扩展：'守卫、防御'（12 世纪）；'约束、阻止'（13 世纪初）；'照顾、保护'（13 世纪中）；'维持、经营'店铺（14 世纪中）；'使不能离开'、'保存而不失不变'（14 世纪末）；'停留、留下'（15 世纪初）；'继续做'（15 世纪中）。

items.en: keep was used to translate both Latin conservare 'preserve, keep safe' and tenere 'keep, retain'. The Latin serv- family gave English preserve, conserve, reserve and observe; it is a separate borrowing, not a cognate.
items.cn: keep 曾同时用来翻译拉丁语 conservare'保存、保护'和 tenere'保持、留住'。拉丁语 serv- 词族给英语留下了 preserve、conserve、reserve、observe；这是另一条借入路径，不是同源词。

items.en: Modern English has keep – kept – kept. The noun keep dates from the mid-13th century ('care, heed'); 'castle keep' is from the 1580s; 'food or livelihood' from 1801, with earn one's keep from 1885. For keeps is American colloquial, from 1861.
items.cn: 现代英语的变化是 keep – kept – kept。名词 keep 始见于 13 世纪中（'照料、留意'）；'城堡主楼'义始见于 16 世纪 80 年代；'食物、生计'义始见于 1801 年，earn one's keep 始见于 1885 年。for keeps 是 1861 年起的美式口语。

note.en: Words below are easy to confuse with keep. Sound and spelling first, then meaning.
note.cn: 下面这些词容易和 keep 混淆。先讲读音和拼写，再讲意思。

entries.definition: very eager, or sharp in mind or edge. Same long /iː/ and one syllable, but it ends in -n, not -p.
entries.definitionCN: 热衷的；敏锐的。同样是长音 /iː/、单音节，但结尾是 -n，不是 -p。

entries.definition: to rest with your eyes closed. It rhymes exactly with keep; only the opening sl- differs.
entries.definitionCN: 睡觉。与 keep 完全押韵，只差开头的 sl-。

entries.definition: a small, strong car for rough ground. Same rhyme, but it starts with the affricate /dʒ/.
entries.definitionCN: 吉普车。押韵相同，但开头是塞擦音 /dʒ/。

entries.definition: a cloak, or a point of land into the sea. The spelling looks like keep, but the vowel is /eɪ/, not /iː/.
entries.definitionCN: 披风；海角。拼写像 keep，但元音是 /eɪ/，不是 /iː/。

entries.definition: This is keep's own past tense and past participle, not another word. One syllable, short /e/, ending in -t.
entries.definitionCN: 这就是 keep 自己的过去式和过去分词，不是另一个词。单音节，短音 /e/，结尾是 -t。

entries.definition: going far down or far in. It rhymes with keep and differs only in the first letter.
entries.definitionCN: 深的。与 keep 押韵，只差第一个字母。

entries.definition: to look quickly and secretly. It uses the same letters as keep in a different order, with the same sound pattern.
entries.definitionCN: 偷看。字母和 keep 相同只是顺序不同，读音模式也一样。

entries.definition: a large brown seaweed. It starts with kel- and ends in -p, but the vowel is short /e/.
entries.definitionCN: 海带（大型褐藻）。开头是 kel-、结尾是 -p，但元音是短音 /e/。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real phrases and real compounds that show the same 'continue, maintain' idea.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的短语和复合词，它们都体现同一个'持续、维持'的想法。

normal.en: keep the change — the money stays with you instead of going back to the cashier; keep means 'continue to have'.
normal.cn: keep the change —— 钱留在你这里，不再回到收银员手里；keep 就是'继续拥有'。

normal.en: keep a promise — the promise is watched over until it is carried out; this is the oldest recorded sense of keep, 'observe'.
normal.cn: keep a promise —— 承诺被看住，直到兑现；这正是 keep 最早被记录的义项'遵守'。

normal.en: keep a shop / keep bees — keep here means tend and maintain. This is the 'watch over' layer that the verb started from.
normal.cn: keep a shop / keep bees —— 这里的 keep 是'照料、维持'。这就是这个词出发时的那层'看管'意思。

normal.en: earn your keep — keep as a noun is the food and shelter that maintain you; working for it means paying for that maintenance.
normal.cn: earn your keep —— 名词 keep 指维持你生活的食宿；为它干活，就是为这份'维持'付账。

normal.en: keepsake = keep + sake: an object kept for the sake of the person who gave it.
normal.cn: keepsake = keep + sake：为了送给你的人而一直留着的物件，也就是纪念品。

abstract.en: Abstractly, keep is a line, not a frame: the same state repeated along time. Symbol: ●━━━● — same dot, unbroken line.
abstract.cn: 抽象地看，keep 是一条线，而不是一个框：同一状态沿着时间重复。符号：●━━━● —— 同一个点，一条不断的线。

abstract.en: Where hold stops something from leaving, keep stops something from changing: a kept promise, a kept record, a kept habit. Guarding is the daily maintenance of that line. Symbol: ●━━━● with a watchful eye above it.
abstract.cn: hold 阻止东西离开，keep 阻止东西改变：守住的承诺、保存的记录、保持的习惯。'看守'就是每天给这条线做维护。符号：●━━━●，上方再加一只留意的眼睛。

abstract.en: The line can also be a supply: what you keep, you continue to have — a shop, animals, food, a livelihood. Continuity becomes sustenance. Symbol: ●━━━● turning into a bowl at the end.
abstract.cn: 这条线也可以是一份供给：你 keep 的东西，你就继续拥有——店铺、牲畜、食物、生计。'延续'于是变成'养命'。符号：●━━━●，线尾变成一个碗。

examples.en: You can keep the change.
She kept working until midnight.
Can you keep a secret?

dict_mnemonic.text: 科普（keep）—— 好的科普知识值得一直保留、别丢 → keep

groups.root: 源自晚期古英语 cēpan（看守、留意），词源本身不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Ten common senses of keep. One idea runs through them: a state is continued, and continuing it takes care.
sensesIntro.cn: keep 的十个常见义项。一个想法贯穿其中：让某种状态持续下去，而持续需要照料。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hold a state or thing steady through time — continuity, not grip.
core.cn: 核心意象：让某个状态或东西在时间中稳定延续——重点是连续，不是抓握。

branches.en: CONTINUATION: possession, a state, or an action simply goes on — the same thing across more time.
branches.cn: 延续：所有物、状态或动作只是继续下去——同一个东西占据更多时间。

branches.en: WATCHING OVER: a promise is observed and a secret is guarded; both need attention holding the line.
branches.cn: 看管：承诺被遵守，秘密被守住；两者都需要注意力把这条线按住。

branches.en: BOUNDARY: a fence keeps animals in — the frame itself does the holding.
branches.cn: 边界：栅栏把牲畜拦在里面——起'握'作用的是框本身。

branches.en: MAINTENANCE: animals and shops need daily care; food keeps when its good state lasts.
branches.cn: 维持：牲畜和店铺需要天天照料；食物的'好状态'能持续，就是保鲜。

branches.en: NOUN: what maintains you (keep = food and lodging), and the stronghold that holds out — for keeps means for good.
branches.cn: 名词：维持你生活的东西（keep 指食宿），以及守住不放的据点——for keeps 就是'永久地'。

intro.en: keep forms real compounds with -er, -ing and everyday nouns; each one keeps the core idea of continuing or maintaining.
intro.cn: keep 与 -er、-ing 以及日常名词构成真实的复合词；每一个都保留了'持续、维持'的核心意思。

latinIntro.en: Latin servare 'to keep safe' (stem serv-) produced preserve, conserve, reserve and observe — a separate borrowing with the same core meaning, not a cognate of keep.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 servare'保全'（词干 serv-）产生了 preserve、conserve、reserve、observe——这是另一条借入路径，核心意思相同，但不是 keep 的同源词。

items.meaning: a person who looks after something, such as animals or a place
items.meaningCN: 看守人、饲养员；守门员（-er 表示做这个动作的人）
items.example: The keeper feeds the animals at six.
items.exampleCN: 饲养员六点喂动物。

items.meaning: the act of keeping something; also agreement or harmony
items.meaningCN: 保管；保持一致、协调（-ing 把动作变成名词）
items.example: The new building is in keeping with the old town.
items.exampleCN: 新建筑与老城区风格协调。

items.meaning: an object kept because it reminds you of a person or event
items.meaningCN: 纪念品（为了某个人或某件事而留着的物件）
items.example: She gave me a photo as a keepsake.
items.exampleCN: 她送我一张照片作纪念。

items.meaning: the work of cleaning and running a home; also money for household costs
items.meaningCN: 家务；家用（料理一个家的日常维持）
items.example: They share the housekeeping and the bills.
items.exampleCN: 他们共同承担家务和开销。

items.meaning: the work and money needed to keep something in good condition
items.meaningCN: 保养；保养费（up- 表示'维持良好状态'）
items.example: The upkeep of the old house is expensive.
items.exampleCN: 这栋老房子的保养费用很高。

items.meaning: a person who keeps and raises bees
items.meaningCN: 养蜂人（饲养蜜蜂的人）
items.example: The beekeeper sells honey at the market.
items.exampleCN: 养蜂人在市场上卖蜂蜜。

latinEntries.meaning: to keep something safe from harm or decay
to keep something from being lost or wasted
to keep something back for later use; to book
to watch something carefully; to keep a rule or custom

groups.definition_en: to move around an axis or change direction; to become
groups.scene: 路口问路 Turn left at the corner.
groups.sceneCN: 这里 turn 是「转向」（第 2 个义项：改变行进方向）；句意：在拐角处左转。

senses.title: Rotate: spin around a fixed axis
senses.titleCN: 旋转：绕着一个固定的轴转
senses.definition: to move in a circle around a center or axis
senses.definitionCN: 绕中心或轴转动；使旋转
senses.example: Turn the wheel slowly with both hands.
senses.exampleCN: 用双手慢慢转动方向盘。
senses.why: The oldest layer of turn is a lathe. Latin tornus means lathe, and tornare means to round a piece of wood while it spins about a fixed point. The core image is a fixed center with everything else revolving around it.
senses.whyCN: turn 最古老的一层意思来自车床。拉丁语 tornus 就是“车床”，tornare 指让木料绕一个固定点旋转着被削圆。因此核心意象是：中心不动，其余部分绕着它转。

senses.title: Change direction: turn left or right
senses.titleCN: 转向：左转、右转、改变行进方向
senses.definition: to change the direction in which you are moving or facing
senses.definitionCN: 改变行进或面对的方向；转向
senses.example: Turn left at the next corner.
senses.exampleCN: 在下一个路口左转。
senses.why: A person walking is a body with a facing. Turning is simply rotating that body around its own vertical axis, so the same word that spins a wheel also redirects a walker.
senses.whyCN: 走路的人是一个带“朝向”的身体。转向就是让这个身体绕自身的竖直轴旋转，所以让轮子旋转的词，也能让走路的人改变方向。

senses.title: Turn into: become something else
senses.titleCN: 变成：转化为另一种事物
senses.definition: to change into a different substance, form, or kind
senses.definitionCN: 变成；转化为（另一种物质、形态或种类）
senses.example: The water turned into ice overnight.
senses.exampleCN: 水一夜之间结成了冰。
senses.why: On a lathe a block of wood is spun and cut until it leaves as a new shape: the material stays, the form changes. Turn into keeps that workshop image of something being reworked into another form.
senses.whyCN: 在车床上，一块木头被旋转着切削，最后以新的形状离开：材料没变，形态变了。turn into 保留的就是这个作坊画面——东西被转着加工成了另一种形态。

senses.title: Flip or reverse: turn a page
senses.titleCN: 翻转：翻页、翻面、里外掉个个儿
senses.definition: to move something so that the other side is showing or facing up
senses.definitionCN: 翻转；把（某物）翻面，使另一面朝上或朝外
senses.example: Turn the page and read the next paragraph.
senses.exampleCN: 翻到下一页，读下一段。
senses.why: Half a rotation presents the other side. A page, a pancake, a sleeve and a pocket all have two faces; turning is the 180-degree move that swaps which face you see.
senses.whyCN: 转半圈就会露出另一面。书页、煎饼、袖子、口袋都有两面，turn 就是转 180 度，把你看的那一面换掉。

senses.title: Become: turn pale, turn thirty
senses.titleCN: 变得：脸色变化、年龄到了某个数
senses.definition: to become a particular state, colour, or age, often without control
senses.definitionCN: 变得（某种状态、颜色）；到（某个年龄）
senses.example: Her face turned pale when she heard the news.
senses.exampleCN: 听到这个消息，她脸色变得煞白。
senses.why: A state has a visible face: flushed or pale, fresh or sour. Changing state is that face turning to its opposite. Age works the same way: the dial of years clicks round to a new number.
senses.whyCN: 状态有一张看得见的“脸”：红润或苍白，新鲜或发酸。状态改变，就是这张脸转到了相反的一面。年龄也一样：年份的表盘转到了新的数字。

senses.title: Turn to or turn against: change sides
senses.titleCN: 转向某人求助；转而反对
senses.definition: to change whom you face, support, or rely on
senses.definitionCN: 转向（某人求助）；转而反对（原来支持的一方）
senses.example: When he lost his job, he turned to his old teacher for advice.
senses.exampleCN: 失业后，他向当年的老师求助。
senses.why: Loyalty is a direction of facing: an ally faces you, an enemy faces away. So the physical act of turning becomes a change of allegiance: turn to someone for help, turn against or turn on someone in hostility.
senses.whyCN: 忠诚就是一种朝向：盟友面向你，敌人背对你。于是物理上的“转身”变成了立场的改变——turn to 是转过去求助，turn against 或 turn on 是转过去敌对。

senses.title: Turn a profit: convert effort into a result
senses.titleCN: 获利：把投入转化为收益
senses.definition: to produce or earn something, especially money, from what you have
senses.definitionCN: （从原料、投入中）获得、赚得（利润等）；把……变成收益
senses.example: The small bakery turned a profit in its second year.
senses.exampleCN: 这家小面包店第二年就开始盈利。
senses.why: The lathe takes raw material and delivers a finished product. Turn a profit uses the same picture with money as the output: effort and stock are rotated into earnings.
senses.whyCN: 车床把原料加工成成品。turn a profit 用的是同一幅图，只是产出换成了钱：投入和存货被“转”成了利润。

senses.title: A turn: your share in a rotation
senses.definition: the time when it is your chance to do something, in a fixed order
senses.definitionCN: （按顺序轮到的）轮次；机会
senses.example: It is your turn to speak.
senses.exampleCN: 轮到你发言了。
senses.why: A wheel that comes round brings each spoke to the top in order. One full rotation gives every spoke one turn, so a turn became a person's slot in a repeating order.
senses.whyCN: 轮子转一圈，每根辐条依次转到最上面。转一整圈，每根辐条就轮到一次，于是 a turn 成了一个人在循环顺序里的那一次机会。

senses.title: A turn: a bend in the road
senses.titleCN: 转弯处：路上拐弯的地方
senses.definition: a place where a road or path changes direction
senses.definitionCN: （道路的）转弯处；拐弯
senses.example: There is a sharp turn just after the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 过了桥就有一个急转弯。
senses.why: A path that keeps changing direction traces an arc; the point where it bends is a turn. From there it is a short step to the abstract turning point, where a life or a story changes direction.
senses.whyCN: 不断改变方向的路会画出一条弧线，拐弯的那个点就是 a turn。由此再走一小步，就是抽象的 turning point——人生或故事改变方向的转折点。

senses.title: Turn out: the way things end up
senses.titleCN: 结果是：事情最后变成什么样
senses.definition: to happen or be found in a particular way in the end
senses.definitionCN: 结果是；原来是；最后发现是
senses.example: The party turned out better than we expected.
senses.exampleCN: 聚会的结果比我们预想的好。
senses.why: When the rotation stops, the work presents its finished face. Turn out applies that last look to events: after all the turning, this is the face the situation shows.
senses.whyCN: 旋转停下来时，工件呈现出它完工的那一面。turn out 把这个“最后一面”用到事情上：转来转去之后，事情露出的就是这张脸。

intro.en: turn is not a native English word. It came from French, and French took it from the Latin word for a lathe. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: turn 不是英语本族词。它从法语进来，而法语又是从拉丁语里“车床”这个词借来的。年代为大致估计。

items.en: turnian meant 'to rotate, revolve; move about an axis, center, or fixed position'. English also borrowed the same verb from Old French torner, and the two forms reinforced each other.
items.cn: 古英语 turnian 意为“旋转、绕转；绕轴心或固定位置运动”。英语同时从古法语借入了同一个动词 torner，两种形式互相加强。

items.en: torner, turner meant 'to turn away or around; draw aside; change, transform; turn on a lathe' (modern French tourner). This is the form that supplied the everyday English verb.
items.cn: 古法语 torner、turner 意为“转开、转动；拉开；改变、变形；在车床上车削”（现代法语 tourner）。日常英语里的 turn 主要来自这一形式。

items.en: tornare 'to polish, round off, fashion, turn on a lathe', from tornus 'lathe'. The lathe is the key image: the work spins, the chisel stays still, and a new shape appears.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tornare 意为“打磨、削圆、加工成形、在车床上车削”，来自 tornus“车床”。车床是关键意象：工件转，刀具不动，新形状就出现了。

items.en: Greek tornos 'lathe, tool for drawing circles' is the next step back, traced by Watkins to PIE *tere- 'to rub, turn'. The PIE root is a reconstruction, not a recorded word.
items.cn: 再往前是希腊语 tornos“车床、画圆工具”。Watkins 把它追溯到原始印欧语词根 *tere-“摩擦、转”。这个印欧词根是重构出来的，并没有直接文献记录。

items.en: By the mid-14c English used turn for 'shape while rotating on a lathe', and from that came 'form, fashion, shape in any way'. The senses 'change direction', 'change into' and 'change state' are recorded from the 12c–14c. The abstract senses are the workshop image applied to life.
items.cn: 到 14 世纪中期，英语已用 turn 表示“在车床上旋转着加工成形”，由此发展出“塑造、使成形”的一般意思。“改变方向”“变成”“改变状态”等义在 12 至 14 世纪已有记录。抽象义就是把作坊里的画面搬到生活里。

items.en: The verb is regular: turn – turned – turned – turning. The noun turn is recorded from c. 1300 as an act of turning; the senses 'one's turn in an order' and 'a bend in a road' developed later from the same rotation image.
items.cn: 动词变化规则：turn – turned – turned – turning。名词 turn 约 1300 年已有“一次转动”的记录；“按顺序轮到的一次”和“路上的转弯处”都是后来从同一个旋转意象发展出来的。

note.en: Words below are easily confused with turn. The notes start with sound and spelling, then meaning.
note.cn: 下面这些词容易和 turn 混淆。说明先讲读音和拼写，再讲意思。

entries.definition: a seabird with long pointed wings. It is a homophone of turn but has nothing to do with rotation.
entries.definitionCN: 一种长翅尖翼的海鸟。和 turn 同音，但与“转”毫无关系。

entries.definition: to be on fire, or to damage something with fire. Only the first consonant differs: b instead of t.
entries.definitionCN: 燃烧；烧毁。只有第一个辅音不同：b 代替 t。

entries.definition: to gain knowledge or skill. It rhymes with turn but begins with l.
entries.definitionCN: 学习；获知。与 turn 押韵，但以 l 开头。

entries.definition: to come or go back. It is re- 'back' + turn, so it is a member of the family, not a stranger.
entries.definitionCN: 返回；归还。它是 re-（回）+ turn，是本词族的成员，不是易混的陌生词。

entries.definition: past participle of tear, meaning 'ripped'. It looks like turn but has a different vowel and a different verb behind it.
entries.definitionCN: tear（撕）的过去分词，意为“撕破的”。形状像 turn，但元音不同，来源动词也不同。

entries.definition: a round root vegetable. Its first element is probably turn, from its round shape, as if it had been turned on a lathe; the second is nepe, an old word for turnip.
entries.definitionCN: 萝卜（一种圆形根菜）。它的前半部分很可能就是 turn，取“圆得像在车床上车出来”的意思；后半部分 nepe 是“萝卜”的古词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real, explainable links — compounds, prefixes and everyday scenes, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实、可解释的联系——复合词、前缀和日常场景，而不是编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: return = re- (back) + turn: to turn back toward the place you came from.
normal.cn: return = re-（回）+ turn：转回到你来的地方。

normal.en: turnstile = turn + stile (a step over a fence): a gate whose arms turn as each person passes.
normal.cn: turnstile = turn + stile（翻越栅栏的踏步）：每过一个人，闸臂就转一下的闸机。

normal.en: turnover = turn + over: money that turns over in a shop, or staff who turn over when they leave and are replaced.
normal.cn: turnover = turn + over：店里资金“转”一圈的营业额，或员工走了又补上的人员更替。

normal.en: turn a page = a 180-degree turn. The paper does not slide sideways; it rotates.
normal.cn: turn a page = 转 180 度。纸不是横着挪走，而是整片翻过去。

normal.en: turn pale = the face turns to its opposite state, like a dial clicking round to a new number.
normal.cn: turn pale = 脸转到相反的状态，就像表盘“咔”地转到新数字。

abstract.en: turn is an arc around a fixed point. The axis never moves; only the facing changes.
abstract.cn: turn 是绕固定点画出的一段弧：轴心始终不动，改变的只是朝向。

abstract.en: That is why turn can change direction, state, loyalty or fortune without changing identity: the thing stays, its face rotates.
abstract.cn: 所以 turn 能改变方向、状态、立场或运势，却不改变事物本身：东西还在，只是脸转过去了。

abstract.en: Every extended sense is the same geometry seen from another angle — a page, a road, a year, a market, an ally.
abstract.cn: 所有引申义都是同一套几何从不同角度去看——一页纸、一条路、一年、一个市场、一个盟友。

examples.en: Turn left at the next corner.
The milk has turned sour.
It is your turn to speak.

dict_mnemonic.text: 特恩（turn）—— 车轮一转，就转到特别恩待你的方向 → turn

groups.root: 源自拉丁语 tornus（车床），经古法语 tourner 进入英语，核心是“绕轴旋转”。

sensesIntro.en: Ten common senses of turn. Each grows from one core image: something revolves around a fixed axis, and everything else follows from which side now faces you.
sensesIntro.cn: turn 的十个常见义项。每一个都从同一个核心意象长出来：某物绕一个固定的轴旋转，接下来的一切都取决于现在哪一面朝向你。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fixed axis → rotation → a different face or direction → a different state.
core.cn: 核心意象：固定的轴 → 旋转 → 换成另一面或另一个方向 → 进入另一种状态。

branches.en: PHYSICAL ROTATION: a wheel, a page, a pancake — the object spins or flips around its own center.
branches.cn: 物理旋转：车轮、书页、煎饼——物体绕自己的中心转动或翻转。

branches.en: DIRECTION IN SPACE: a body or a road changes the line it follows; the bend itself becomes a noun.
branches.cn: 空间里的方向：身体或道路改变所走的线，拐弯的地方本身也成了名词。

branches.en: BECOMING: a thing keeps its identity but presents a new form or state, like wood reshaped on a lathe.
branches.cn: 变成：事物保持自身，却呈现新的形态或状态，就像木料在车床上被重新成型。

branches.en: FACING: loyalty is which side you face, and the outcome is the face a situation shows when the turning stops.
branches.cn: 朝向：忠诚就是你面向哪一边；结果则是转完停下时事情露出的那张脸。

branches.en: PRODUCTION AND SUCCESSION: raw material turned into output; a wheel turned once gives each spoke its turn.
branches.cn: 产出与轮替：原料被转成产出；轮子转一圈，每根辐条就轮到一次。

intro.en: turn is a productive element: prefixes and suffixes aim its idea of rotation at direction, return, reversal and output.
intro.cn: turn 是一个能产的构词成分：前缀和后缀把它“旋转”的意思引向方向、返回、翻转和产出。

latinIntro.en: turn is itself a Latin word borrowed through French: Latin tornare 'to turn on a lathe' and tornus 'lathe'. Other English words from the same Latin line came through French as well.
latinIntro.cn: turn 本身就是经法语借入的拉丁词：拉丁语 tornare“在车床上车削”和 tornus“车床”。同一拉丁来源的其他英语词也都经法语进来。

items.structure: turn + -ing（名词后缀，表动作或结果）
items.meaning: the act of rotating; a place where a road bends
items.meaningCN: 旋转；（道路的）转弯处
items.example: Slow down before the turning.
items.exampleCN: 进转弯处前要减速。

items.meaning: a person who works with a lathe; a flat tool for turning food
items.meaningCN: 车工；翻铲（做翻面动作的工具）
items.example: My uncle is a skilled turner.
items.exampleCN: 我叔叔是个熟练的车工。

items.meaning: to come or go back to a place
items.meaningCN: 返回；归还（re- 表示“回、再次”）
items.example: She returned home at six.
items.exampleCN: 她六点回了家。

items.meaning: to turn something over; to cancel a decision officially
items.meaningCN: 使翻倒；推翻（决定、判决）（over- 表示“翻过、在上方”）
items.example: The court overturned the old ruling.
items.exampleCN: 法院推翻了旧裁决。

items.meaning: an improvement or rise in a situation
items.meaningCN: 好转；上升（up- 表示“向上”）
items.example: The market showed a slight upturn.
items.exampleCN: 市场出现小幅回升。

items.meaning: the money a business receives; the rate at which staff leave and are replaced
items.meaningCN: 营业额；（人员的）更替率
items.example: The shop has a daily turnover of two thousand dollars.
items.exampleCN: 这家店日营业额两千美元。

items.meaning: a rotating gate that lets one person through at a time
items.meaningCN: 旋转闸机（一次只过一人的转门）
items.example: Tap your card at the turnstile.
items.exampleCN: 在闸机处刷一下卡。

latinEntries.structure: 古法语 tour < tourner（转、绕行）
latinEntries.meaning: a journey that goes round a series of places; a shift or period of duty

latinEntries.structure: 古法语 torneiement < torneier（转身、比武）
latinEntries.meaning: a competition in which players or teams meet in a series of games
a band twisted tight to stop blood flowing from a limb
latinEntries.meaningCN: 止血带（绞紧以止血的带子）

latinEntries.meaning: a person who travels to places for pleasure

groups.definition_en: to put something in a fixed place or position; to adjust or fix
groups.core_image: 把东西固定到某个位置
groups.scene: 设闹钟 Set the alarm for 7.
groups.sceneCN: 这里 set 是「设定」（第 4 个义项：把装置调到某个值）；句意：把闹钟设到 7 点。

pos.zh: 放置；设定；使处于（某状态）

senses.title: Place: put something down in a spot
senses.titleCN: 放置：把东西稳当地放到某个位置
senses.definition: to put something in a particular place, often carefully or deliberately
senses.definitionCN: 放置；安放（常指有意识地、稳当地放）
senses.example: She set the vase on the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 她把花瓶放在架子上。
senses.why: Old English settan is the causative of sittan 'to sit': it means 'cause to sit'. So set does not merely move a thing; it makes the thing sit down in a place and stay there.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 settan 是 sittan（坐）的使役形式，意思是“使……坐”。所以 set 不只是移动东西，而是让东西在某个位置上“坐下来”并待在那里。

senses.title: Fix: hold something firmly in position
senses.titleCN: 固定：让东西牢牢待在原位
senses.definition: to fix something in position so that it cannot move
senses.definitionCN: 使固定；使牢固地处于某个位置
senses.example: The doctor set the broken bone in a cast.
senses.exampleCN: 医生把断骨复位固定，打上石膏。
senses.why: Settan also carried the sense 'fix firmly'. Once an object has been made to sit, the next idea is that it stays seated: a gem is set in a ring, a bone is set back in place.
senses.whyCN: settan 还带有“牢牢固定”的意思。东西被“使坐”之后，下一步就是“坐住不动”：宝石被嵌在戒指上，断骨被固定回原位。

senses.title: Arrange: set the table
senses.definition: to arrange objects in the order or positions they should have
senses.definitionCN: 布置；安排；把……摆放整齐
senses.example: Could you set the table for dinner?
senses.exampleCN: 你能摆好餐具准备吃晚饭吗？
senses.why: Arrangement is many small placements in a pattern. Set the table means make each plate, glass and fork sit in its assigned spot, so the whole table is set.
senses.whyCN: 布置就是按一个图案做很多次小“放置”。set the table 就是让每个盘子、杯子、叉子都坐到指定位置，于是整张桌子就“摆好了”。

senses.title: Adjust: set a device to a chosen value
senses.titleCN: 设定：把装置调到某个值
senses.definition: to adjust a clock, machine, or control so that it works at a chosen time or level
senses.definitionCN: 设定、调校（钟表、机器、控制器到某个时间或数值）
senses.example: Set the alarm for seven.
senses.exampleCN: 把闹钟设到七点。
senses.why: A dial is an object set at a mark. Setting the alarm places the pointer in a fixed spot so that the machine acts when it reaches that spot. Physical placement becomes a numeric setting.
senses.whyCN: 表盘就是一个被“放”在某个刻度上的东西。设闹钟就是把指针放到固定的一点，机器走到那一点就动作。物理上的“放置”由此变成了数值上的“设定”。

senses.title: Establish: set a date, rule, or record
senses.titleCN: 确定：定下日期、规则、纪录
senses.definition: to decide and fix something such as a date, price, rule, or record
senses.definitionCN: 确定；规定；创下（日期、价格、规则、纪录）
senses.example: They set a date for the wedding.
senses.exampleCN: 他们定下了婚礼日期。
senses.why: Once a thing is fixed in place, it cannot move. A date, a price and a rule are fixed points that everyone must work around. A record is a mark set so high that later attempts are measured against it.
senses.whyCN: 东西一旦被固定在位置上，就不能动了。日期、价格、规则都是大家必须围着它安排的固定点。纪录则是一个被“放”得很高的刻度，后来者都要对着它量。

senses.title: Harden: glue or concrete sets
senses.titleCN: 凝固：胶水、混凝土变硬定型
senses.definition: to become solid, firm, or permanent, especially of glue, concrete, or jelly
senses.definitionCN: （胶水、混凝土、果冻等）凝固、变硬、定型
senses.example: Let the glue set before you use the cup.
senses.exampleCN: 等胶水凝固后再用杯子。
senses.why: This is the intransitive direction of the same image: instead of someone making a thing sit, the material sits down by itself. Particles stop moving, the mass rests, and it is set.
senses.whyCN: 这是同一意象的不及物方向：不是有人让东西坐下，而是材料自己“坐下来”。颗粒停止运动，整团东西静止下来，于是它凝固了。

senses.title: Go down: the sun sets
senses.definition: to go down below the horizon, used of the sun, moon, or stars
senses.definitionCN: （太阳、月亮、星星）落到地平线以下；落下
senses.example: The sun sets behind the hills at six.
senses.exampleCN: 六点太阳落在山后。
senses.why: The sun does not literally sit, but it appears to descend and rest below the horizon. English uses the same 'sink down, settle' image here that gives us settle.
senses.whyCN: 太阳并不是真的“坐”，但它看起来下降并停在地平线以下。英语在这里用的正是与 settle 同源的“下沉、安顿”意象。

senses.title: Put into a state: set something free
senses.definition: to cause someone or something to be in a particular state
senses.definitionCN: 使……处于某种状态（set free 释放；set on fire 点燃）
senses.example: The birds were set free at the edge of the forest.
senses.exampleCN: 鸟儿在森林边上被放生了。
senses.why: The place where an object is set can be abstract. Instead of a shelf, the location is a condition: free, on fire, in motion. The grammar stays the same: set + object + state.
senses.whyCN: 东西被“放”的位置可以是抽象的。那个位置不再是一个架子，而是一种状态：自由、着火、运转。句型没变——set + 宾语 + 状态。

senses.title: A set: things that belong together
senses.titleCN: 一套：归在一起的一组东西
senses.definition: a group of things of the same kind that are used together
senses.definitionCN: 一套；一组（同类且配套使用的东西）
senses.example: She bought a set of kitchen knives.
senses.exampleCN: 她买了一套厨房刀具。
senses.why: A set is things set together: each item was placed with the others, and the group is treated as one fixed unit. The noun keeps the 'placed together' idea of the verb.
senses.whyCN: a set 就是被“放”在一起的东西：每一件都被放到其他件旁边，整组被当成一个固定的单位。名词保留了动词“放置在一起”的意思。

senses.title: A set: the place where a scene happens
senses.definition: the scenery and furniture used for a play or film scene
senses.definitionCN: （戏剧、电影的）布景；场景
senses.example: The crew built a street set in the studio.
senses.exampleCN: 摄制组在摄影棚里搭了一条街的布景。
senses.why: A stage set is scenery set in place: walls, chairs and props are put in fixed positions so the action can happen there. The place itself is built by placement.
senses.whyCN: 舞台布景就是把布景“放”到位：墙、椅子、道具都被固定在特定位置，好让剧情在那里发生。这个“地点”本身是由一次次摆放搭出来的。

intro.en: set is a native Germanic word, not a borrowing. It is the causative partner of sit, and that 'make something sit' idea explains its very wide range. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: set 是土生土长的日耳曼词，不是外来借词。它是 sit 的使役搭档，“让某物坐下”这个意思解释了它为什么用途如此之广。年代为大致估计。

items.en: settan (transitive) meant 'cause to sit; make or cause to rest as on a seat; put in a definite place; arrange, fix, adjust; appoint (a time)'.
items.cn: 古英语 settan（及物）意为“使坐；使像坐在座位上一样安歇；放在确定的位置；安排、固定、调好；定下（时间）”。

items.en: From *(bi)satejanan 'to cause to sit, set', the causative form of the verb that became sit. Cognates include Old Norse setja, Dutch zetten, German setzen and Gothic satjan.
items.cn: 来自原始日耳曼语 *(bi)satejanan“使坐、放置”，它是 sit 那个动词的使役形式。同源词包括古诺斯语 setja、荷兰语 zetten、德语 setzen、哥特语 satjan。

items.en: The whole family goes back to PIE *sed- 'to sit', which also produced Latin sedere 'to sit' and sella 'seat'. The root is a reconstruction, not a recorded word.
items.cn: 整个词族可追溯到原始印欧语 *sed-“坐”，它同时产生了拉丁语 sedere“坐”和 sella“座位”。这个词根是重构出来的，没有直接文献记录。

items.era: THE CAUSATIVE PAIR: SET AND SIT
items.en: English has kept the pair: sit is what you do, set is what you do to something else. Because almost anything can be made to sit somewhere, set became a general-purpose verb, like put. It has been confused with sit since at least the early 14c.
items.cn: 英语保留了这个成对的区分：sit 是你自己坐，set 是你让别的东西坐。因为几乎任何东西都能被“使坐”，set 就成了像 put 一样的万能动词。至少从 14 世纪初起，它就和 sit 发生混淆。

items.en: The verb does not change: set – set – set – setting. The noun set, meaning a group of matching things used together, is recorded in the 15th century and grows from the same 'placed together' idea.
items.cn: 动词变化不变形：set – set – set – setting。名词 set 表示“配套的一组东西”，15 世纪已有记录，也是从“放置在一起”这个意思长出来的。

note.en: set sits inside a cluster of short, similar-looking words. Check the vowel and the final consonant first, then the meaning.
note.cn: set 周围挤着一串又短又像的词。先看元音和词尾辅音，再看意思。

entries.definition: a badger's burrow, or a small paving block. It is a homophone of set but a different noun.
entries.definitionCN: 獾洞；铺路用小石块。和 set 同音，但是另一个名词。

entries.definition: to rest with your weight on your bottom. The vowel is short /ɪ/, not /e/, and sit is what you do to yourself, not to an object.
entries.definitionCN: 坐。元音是短音 /ɪ/，不是 /e/；而且 sit 是自己坐，set 是让别的东西坐。

entries.definition: past tense and past participle of send. It ends in -nt, while set ends in a single t.
entries.definitionCN: send（发送）的过去式和过去分词。词尾是 -nt，而 set 只有一个 t。

entries.definition: a place to sit, or to place someone in one. The vowel is long /iː/ and the word ends in -t after a long vowel.
entries.definitionCN: 座位；使就座。元音是长音 /iː/，拼写以 -t 收尾但读起来更长。

entries.definition: verb: to be seated. One letter differs, but the grammar is opposite: sit is intransitive, set is usually transitive.
entries.definitionCN: 动词：坐着。只差一个字母，但语法相反：sit 不及物，set 通常及物。

entries.definition: verb: past of send. It looks like set with an extra n, and the meaning is sending, not placing.
entries.definitionCN: 动词：send 的过去式。看起来像 set 多了一个 n，意思是“发送”而不是“放置”。

entries.definition: a long soft seat for two or more people. It is probably a variant of settle, the bench, so it is a distant relative rather than the same word.
entries.definitionCN: 长沙发；双人以上座椅。它大概是 settle（长凳）的变体，所以只是远亲，不是同一个词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real, explainable links — the causative pair with sit, compounds, and everyday scenes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实、可解释的联系——与 sit 的使役配对、复合词和日常场景。

normal.en: set = cause to sit. Whenever you set something down, you are making it sit where you want it.
normal.cn: set = 使……坐。每次你把东西放下，都是在让它坐到你想要的位置。

normal.en: set the table: each plate and fork is placed in its own spot, so the whole arrangement is set.
normal.cn: set the table：每个盘子和叉子都放到自己的位置，整个布置就“设定”好了。

normal.en: sunset = sun + set: the sun appears to sink and rest below the horizon.
normal.cn: sunset = sun + set：太阳看起来下沉，停在地平线以下。

normal.en: mindset = mind + set: a way of thinking that has become fixed, like glue that has set.
normal.cn: mindset = mind + set：一种已经固定下来的思维方式，就像凝固了的胶水。

normal.en: set a record: the mark is placed so high that later attempts must be measured against it.
normal.cn: set a record：把刻度放得那么高，后来者都得对着它量。

abstract.en: set is placement that becomes permanence: put a thing down, fix it, and it stays.
abstract.cn: set 是“放置”变成“固定”：把东西放下，固定住，它就留在那里。

abstract.en: Once fixed, the thing can act as a standard — a set clock, a set rule, a set date, a set record.
abstract.cn: 一旦固定，它就能充当标准——调好的钟、定下的规则、定好的日期、创下的纪录。

abstract.en: The same image runs both ways: outward arrangement (a set of tools) and inward settling (glue sets, the sun sets).
abstract.cn: 同一个意象有两个方向：向外的安排（一套工具），以及向内的安顿（胶水凝固、太阳落下）。

examples.en: Set the alarm for seven.
The sun sets behind the hills.
She bought a set of kitchen knives.

dict_mnemonic.text: 塞特（set）—— 塞到特定的位置，它就固定住了 → set

groups.root: 源自古英语 settan“使坐、放置”，是 sittan（坐）的使役形式，核心是“让某物坐下并固定”。

sensesIntro.en: Ten common senses of set. Each grows from one core image: cause something to sit in a place, and then make it stay fixed there.
sensesIntro.cn: set 的十个常见义项。每一个都从同一个核心意象长出来：让某物在某个位置坐下，然后让它固定在那里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cause to sit → rest in a fixed spot → order → permanence.
core.cn: 核心意象：使坐 → 停在固定的位置 → 秩序 → 永久不变。

branches.en: PLACE AND ARRANGE: a thing is made to sit in a spot; many such spots make a table setting.
branches.cn: 放置与布置：让东西坐到某个位置；很多个这样的位置就构成一桌摆设。

branches.en: FIX AND SINK: the sitting becomes permanent or the material sinks down — a gem, a bone, glue, the sun.
branches.cn: 固定与下沉：这个“坐”变成永久状态，或者材料向下沉——宝石、断骨、胶水、太阳。

branches.en: SET A VALUE: a pointer, a date, a rule or a record is pinned to one position and becomes a standard.
branches.cn: 设定数值：指针、日期、规则、纪录被钉在一个位置上，成为标准。

branches.en: SET A STATE: the abstract location is a condition — free, on fire, in motion.
branches.cn: 设定状态：抽象的“位置”就是一种状态——自由、着火、运转。

branches.en: THINGS SET TOGETHER: objects or scenery placed as a group form one set.
branches.cn: 放在一起的事物：物品或布景成组摆放，就构成一个 set。

intro.en: set is a productive element: re-, off-, out- and up- redirect its idea of fixed placement, while -ing turns it into a noun.
intro.cn: set 是一个能产的构词成分：re-、off-、out-、up- 等前缀把它“固定放置”的意思引到新方向，-ing 则使它名词化。

latinIntro.en: set has no Latin borrowing of its own. The only Latin link is distant: PIE *sed- 'to sit' also gave Latin sedere 'to sit' and sella 'seat', the source of English session, sediment and preside. Those are cognates, not derivatives of set.
latinIntro.cn: set 没有自己的拉丁借词来源。它与拉丁语只有很远的联系：原始印欧语 *sed-“坐”同时产生了拉丁语 sedere“坐”和 sella“座位”，英语 session、sediment、preside 来自后者。这些是远亲同源词，不是 set 的派生词。

items.structure: set + -ing（名词后缀，表动作、结果或状态）
items.meaning: the place and time in which something happens; a control on a device
items.meaningCN: 环境；背景；（设备的）设置
items.example: The story has a mountain setting.
items.exampleCN: 这个故事以山区为背景。

items.meaning: to set something again; to return a device to its first state
items.meaningCN: 重新设定；重置（re- 表示“再、重新”）
items.example: Reset the clock after the power cut.
items.exampleCN: 停电之后把钟重新调好。

items.meaning: to balance one cost or effect against another; a difference or displacement
items.meaningCN: 抵消；补偿；偏移量
items.example: Higher sales offset the rise in costs.
items.exampleCN: 销量上升抵消了成本上涨。

items.meaning: the beginning of something
items.meaningCN: 开始；开端（out 表示“向外、出发”）
items.example: He warned us at the outset.
items.exampleCN: 他一开始就提醒过我们。

items.meaning: the time when the sun goes down; also the end of a period
items.meaningCN: 日落；末期（set 指“落下”）
items.example: We watched the sunset from the beach.
items.exampleCN: 我们在海滩上看日落。

items.structure: mind（头脑）+ set（固定下来的东西）
items.meaning: a settled way of thinking
items.meaningCN: 心态；思维定式
items.example: A growth mindset helps you keep learning.
items.exampleCN: 成长型心态能帮你持续学习。

items.structure: 古英语 setlan < setl（座位），与 set 同属“坐”的词族
items.meaning: to come to rest; to live permanently; to decide or arrange
items.meaningCN: 安定；定居；解决（经名词 setl“座位”而来，不是 set + -le 的普通派生）
items.example: They settled in a small town near the coast.
items.exampleCN: 他们在海边一个小镇定居下来。

groups.definition_en: to move something into a place, position, or state
groups.scene: 别拖作业，你说 Don't put off your homework until Sunday.
groups.sceneCN: 这里是「推迟、往后拖」的意思（第 5 个义项：把事挪到更晚再做）；句意：别把作业拖到周日。

senses.title: Place: put something somewhere
senses.titleCN: 放置：把东西放到某个地方
senses.definition: to move something to a particular place and leave it there
senses.definitionCN: 把某物移到某个位置并留在那里；放置
senses.example: Put the keys on the table.
senses.exampleCN: 把钥匙放在桌上。
senses.why: The oldest recorded sense of put is 'thrust, push, shove'. Putting is a directed push: the hand moves an object to a chosen point and lets it rest there. The core is transfer with an endpoint.
senses.whyCN: put 有记录的最早意思是“推、搡、猛推”。放置就是一次有方向的推：手把物体送到选定的点，然后让它停在那里。核心是“转移 + 终点”。

senses.title: Put someone in a state or condition
senses.titleCN: 使处于：使某人进入某种状态
senses.definition: to cause someone or something to be in a particular situation or condition
senses.definitionCN: 使某人／某物处于某种处境或状态
senses.example: That decision put the whole team in danger.
senses.exampleCN: 那个决定让整个团队陷入危险。
senses.why: A person is treated like an object that can be pushed into a place. The place is abstract — danger, prison, at ease — but the geometry is the same: move X into position Y and leave it there.
senses.whyCN: 人被当作可以被推进某个位置的物体。这个位置是抽象的——危险、监狱、自在——但几何关系没变：把 X 移到 Y 位置并留在那里。

senses.title: Express: put it another way
senses.definition: to express an idea in words, especially in a particular way
senses.definitionCN: （用某种方式）表达、说；措辞
senses.example: Let me put it another way.
senses.exampleCN: 让我换个说法。
senses.why: Words are objects placed in a row. To put an idea is to place its meaning into a sentence, slot by slot. How should I put it? is literally asking where to place the meaning so it fits.
senses.whyCN: 词是按顺序排好的物体。把想法“put”出来，就是把意思一个槽一个槽地放进句子里。How should I put it? 字面上就是在问：这个意思放在哪里才合适。

senses.title: Invest or apply: put money into a project
senses.titleCN: 投入：把钱、精力放进某件事
senses.definition: to spend or apply something such as money, time, or effort on a purpose
senses.definitionCN: 把（钱、时间、精力）投入某个用途
senses.example: They put all their savings into the new business.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把全部积蓄投入到新生意里。
senses.why: Money and effort are objects you can push into a target. The endpoint is not a shelf but a project or a person; the transfer is what matters, not the physical contact.
senses.whyCN: 钱和精力是可以被推进某个目标的物体。终点不是架子，而是项目或某个人；重要的是转移，而不是物理接触。

senses.title: Put off: move something to a later time
senses.definition: to delay something until a later time
senses.definitionCN: 推迟；拖延
senses.example: They put off the meeting until Friday.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把会议推迟到星期五。
senses.why: Put off pushes the event away from now. The 'place' is a time slot: what was placed in today is pushed to a later slot. This is the placement image applied to the calendar.
senses.whyCN: put off 把事情从“现在”推开。这里的“位置”是时间段：原本放在今天的事，被推到了后面的槽位。这就是把“放置”用到日历上。

senses.title: Put up with: bear a burden
senses.definition: to accept something unpleasant or difficult without protest
senses.definitionCN: 忍受、容忍（不愉快或困难的事）
senses.example: I can't put up with this noise any longer.
senses.exampleCN: 我再也忍受不了这种噪音了。
senses.why: The image is bearing a weight that has been placed on you: you hold it up instead of dropping it. The exact history of the phrase is disputed, so it is safest to explain the modern image rather than claim a certain origin.
senses.whyCN: 这个意象是扛着一个被放到你身上的重物：你把它撑住，而不是丢下。这个短语的确切来源有争议，所以稳妥的做法是解释它今天的意象，而不是断言某个确定来源。

senses.title: Put on: wear, or pretend
senses.definition: to dress yourself in something, or to pretend to have a quality
senses.definitionCN: 穿上、戴上；装出（某种样子）
senses.example: She put on her coat and left.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿上外套就出门了。
senses.why: Clothes are placed onto the body. A manner or an accent can be placed on the same way, like a costume, so put on also means to wear a false front.
senses.whyCN: 衣服被放到身体上。举止或口音也能以同样的方式“放”上去，就像套上一件戏服，于是 put on 也有了“装出假样子”的意思。

senses.title: Put down: press down, end, or humiliate
senses.definition: to stop something by force; to place something down; to make someone feel small
senses.definitionCN: 镇压；放下；贬低（使某人难堪）
senses.example: The officers put down the revolt in two days.
senses.exampleCN: 官员们两天内镇压了叛乱。
senses.why: Down is the direction of force. A revolt is pushed down until it stops; a person is pushed down with words. The physical downward push becomes social and political suppression.
senses.whyCN: down 是力量的方向。叛乱被按下去直到停止；一个人被话语按下去。物理上的“向下压”就变成了社会和政治上的压制。

senses.title: Put together: assemble parts
senses.definition: to join separate parts so that they form one thing
senses.definitionCN: 把各部分组合起来；组装
senses.example: We put the desk together in an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 我们一小时内就把书桌组装好了。
senses.why: Put together places each part next to the others until a single whole exists. The endpoint is not a location in space but an arrangement: the parts rest in relation to one another.
senses.whyCN: put together 把每个零件放到其他零件旁边，直到出现一个整体。终点不是空间里的某个地点，而是一种排列：各部分彼此相对地停在那里。

senses.title: The shot put: a thrust of weight
senses.definition: the sports event in which a heavy ball is thrown from the shoulder
senses.definitionCN: 推铅球（体育项目）
senses.example: He won a medal in the shot put.
senses.exampleCN: 他在铅球项目上拿了奖牌。
senses.why: The noun put, recorded around 1300, first meant a throw of a heavy weight. The sport keeps the oldest sense of the verb — thrust or shove — and the ball is pushed, not swung.
senses.whyCN: 名词 put 约 1300 年就有记录，最早指“把重物投掷出去”。这项运动保留了动词最古老的意思——推、搡——铅球是被推出去的，不是抡出去的。

intro.en: put is a native English verb of uncertain deeper origin. Its oldest sense is physical thrust, not abstract placement. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: put 是英语本族动词，但更早的来源并不确定。它最早的意思是物理上的“推”，而不是抽象的“放置”。年代为大致估计。

items.en: A verb *putian is not recorded directly but is implied by putung 'a putting, an instigation' and by pytan 'to put out, thrust out' (used of eyes). The meaning was 'to thrust, push, shove'.
items.cn: 动词 *putian 没有直接文献记录，但可以从 putung“一放、鼓动”和 pytan“推出、戳出”（用于眼睛）推知。它的意思是“推、搡、猛推”。

items.en: Probably from a Germanic stem that also gave Danish putte 'to put', Swedish dialect putta, Old Norse pota 'to poke', and Dutch poten 'to plant'. The exact stem is not settled.
items.cn: 可能来自一个日耳曼语词干，同一词干还产生了丹麦语 putte“放”、瑞典方言 putta、古诺斯语 pota“戳”、荷兰语 poten“种植”。确切词干尚无定论。

items.en: There is no agreed Proto-Indo-European root for put. Some dictionaries suggest a link to words for pushing or poking; others simply label it unknown. Treat any single PIE root as a hypothesis, not a fact.
items.cn: put 没有一个公认的原始印欧语词根。有的词典推测它与表示“推、戳”的词有联系，有的干脆标为来源不明。任何单一印欧词根都只能算假说，不能当定论。

items.en: The noun put first meant the act of throwing a heavy weight overhand, as a test of strength. Putt is a Scottish form and pronunciation of the same word (1510s), which is why golf has putt and the sport has the shot put.
items.cn: 名词 put 最早指“把重物从肩上投掷出去”的比力气的动作。putt 是同一个词的苏格兰形式和读音（16 世纪初），所以高尔夫里有 putt，田径里有 shot put。

items.en: The verb is invariant: put – put – put – putting. The older past form putted is recorded in the 14c–15c but is now obsolete; today putted belongs only to the golf verb putt.
items.cn: 动词不变形：put – put – put – putting。更早的过去式 putted 在 14 至 15 世纪有记录，但现在已经废弃；今天 putted 只属于高尔夫动词 putt。

note.en: put is short enough to collide with several words. Check the vowel sound first, then the final consonant.
note.cn: put 太短，容易和好几个词撞上。先看元音，再看词尾辅音。

entries.definition: a gentle golf stroke, or to make one. It began as a Scottish form of put, but its vowel is /ʌ/, not /ʊ/.
entries.definitionCN: 高尔夫轻击；轻推。它原本是 put 的苏格兰形式，但元音读 /ʌ/，不是 /ʊ/。

entries.definition: a round container for cooking or plants. The vowel is open /ɒ/ and the final consonant is t, but the word is unrelated.
entries.definitionCN: 锅；花盆。元音是开口的 /ɒ/，词尾也是 t，但与 put 没有词源关系。

entries.definition: a flat-bottomed boat, or to kick a ball after dropping it. It ends in -nt, while put ends in a single t.
entries.definitionCN: 平底船；踢落地球。词尾是 -nt，而 put 只有一个 t。

entries.definition: golf term: a soft stroke toward the hole. One extra t, a different vowel, and a much narrower meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 高尔夫术语：朝洞轻推。多一个 t，元音不同，意思也窄得多。

entries.definition: noun: a container. It differs by one letter and one vowel sound, and is not related.
entries.definitionCN: 名词：容器（锅、盆）。只差一个字母和一个元音，且没有词源关系。

entries.definition: to push out your lips in displeasure. It looks like put with an extra o, but the vowel is the diphthong /aʊ/.
entries.definitionCN: 噘嘴（不高兴）。看起来像 put 多了一个 o，但元音是双元音 /aʊ/。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real, explainable links — compounds, prepositions and everyday scenes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实、可解释的联系——复合词、介词搭配和日常场景。

normal.en: input / output = put in / put out: data or goods are placed into or out of a system.
normal.cn: input / output = put in / put out：数据或货物被放进系统，或从系统里出来。

normal.en: put off = push something away from now, into a later time slot.
normal.cn: put off = 把事情从“现在”推开，推到后面的时间段。

normal.en: put on clothes = place cloth onto the body; put on an accent = place a costume onto the voice.
normal.cn: put on clothes = 把布放到身上；put on an accent = 给声音套上一件戏服。

normal.en: shot put: the athlete thrusts the ball from the shoulder, which is the verb's oldest 'push' sense.
normal.cn: shot put：运动员把球从肩上推出去，这正是这个动词最古老的“推”的意思。

normal.en: put up with = hold up a weight placed on you; the modern image is clear even though the phrase's origin is disputed.
normal.cn: put up with = 撑住一个被放到你身上的重物；尽管这个短语的来源有争议，今天的意象是清楚的。

abstract.en: put is a transfer arrow: hand → push → a resting point. The thing changes location, and everything else is metaphor.
abstract.cn: put 是一支转移箭头：手 → 推 → 一个停下的点。东西改变了位置，其余都是比喻。

abstract.en: The resting point can be a place, a state, a sentence slot, a time slot, or a person's mind — the geometry never changes.
abstract.cn: 这个停下的点可以是地点、状态、句子里的槽位、时间段，或一个人的头脑——几何关系始终不变。

abstract.en: Because the verb is so bare, English lets the preposition supply the meaning: put in, out, on, off, down, together.
abstract.cn: 因为这个动词本身太“空”，英语就让后面的介词提供意义：put in、out、on、off、down、together。

examples.en: Put the keys on the table.
Let me put it another way.
They put off the meeting until Friday.
examples.cn: 他们把会议推迟到星期五。

dict_mnemonic.text: 扑特（put）—— 轻轻一扑，把东西放到特定位置 → put

groups.root: 源自古英语 *putian（推、放），更早来源不明；核心是“用手把东西推放到某处”。

sensesIntro.en: Ten common senses of put. Each grows from one core image: a hand pushes an object to a chosen point and lets it rest there.
sensesIntro.cn: put 的十个常见义项。每一个都从同一个核心意象长出来：手把物体推到选定的点，然后让它停在那里。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hand → push → chosen point → the object rests there.
core.cn: 核心意象：手 → 推 → 选定的点 → 物体停在那里。

branches.en: PHYSICAL PLACEMENT: push an object to a spot, place parts together, or thrust a weight away.
branches.cn: 物理放置：把物体推到某处、把零件放到一起，或把重物推出去。

branches.en: STATE AND FORCE: the endpoint is a condition or a downward pressure — danger, a worn coat, a suppressed revolt.
branches.cn: 状态与力量：终点是一种处境或向下的压力——危险、穿上的外套、被压下的叛乱。

branches.en: WORDS AS OBJECTS: meaning is placed into sentence slots, one word at a time.
branches.cn: 词也是物体：意思被一个词一个词地放进句子的槽位里。

branches.en: RESOURCES PUSHED IN: money, time and effort are transferred into a target and left there.
branches.cn: 资源被推入：钱、时间、精力被转移到某个目标里并留在那里。

branches.en: TIME AND BURDEN: the endpoint can be a later time slot, or a weight you must hold up.
branches.cn: 时间与负担：终点可以是后面的时间段，也可以是一个你必须撑住的重量。

intro.en: put combines freely with particles: in, out, down, on and through all specify where the object is pushed or what state it lands in.
intro.cn: put 能自由地和小品词组合：in、out、down、on、through 都指明东西被推向哪里，或落进什么状态。

latinIntro.en: put has no reliable Latin source, and it is not related to Latin ponere 'to put, place' (the source of compose, deposit, position, postpone). Those words mean 'put', but they are a separate Latin family, so they are not listed here as relatives.
latinIntro.cn: put 没有可靠的拉丁语来源，也和拉丁语 ponere“放置”（compose、deposit、position、postpone 的来源）没有关系。那些词虽然也表示“放”，但属于另一个拉丁词族，所以不能当作 put 的亲属列在这里。

items.meaning: data, energy, or advice put into a system or process
items.meaningCN: 输入；投入（in 表示“进入”）
items.example: The program waits for user input.
items.exampleCN: 程序在等待用户输入。

items.meaning: what a system, factory, or person produces
items.meaningCN: 输出；产量（out 表示“出来”）
items.example: The factory doubled its output last year.
items.exampleCN: 这家工厂去年产量翻了一番。

items.meaning: a remark that makes someone feel small or foolish
items.meaningCN: 贬低的话；羞辱（由 put down“压下”转成名词）
items.example: That was a cruel put-down.
items.exampleCN: 那是一句很刻薄的贬低。

items.meaning: a deception, or a joke that pretends to be real
items.meaningCN: 假扮；骗局（由 put on“穿上、装出”转成名词）
items.example: His accent was just a put-on.
items.exampleCN: 他的口音只是装出来的。

items.structure: put + -er（做动作的人或物）；高尔夫义来自 putt + -er
items.meaning: one who puts (rare); a golf club used for gentle strokes — but that club is named from putt, not from this verb
items.meaningCN: 放置者（少见）；高尔夫轻击杆——但这一支来自 putt，不是 put + -er 的常规派生
items.example: She chose a putter for the short final shot.
items.exampleCN: 最后一杆距离很短，她选了轻击杆。

items.meaning: the amount of material or work processed in a given time
items.meaningCN: 吞吐量；处理量（through 表示“穿过”）
items.example: The new system raised throughput by a third.
items.exampleCN: 新系统把处理量提高了三分之一。
